production_source.mesh_and_regularization_adapt_image: subhalo_validation scripts/pipelines/spec.py:9-36 capped_galaxy_name_image_dict_from (S/N capped at 3.0); used by delaunay_adapt_split.py:123,:165 and rectangular_adapt.py:109
production_source.model_stand_in: no previous-stage fit exists in a profiling cell: the dataset's truth tracer (tracer.json) stands in for the maximum-likelihood model whose lens light is subtracted
production_source.over_sampling: subhalo_validation scripts/imaging.py:213-255 apply_adaptive_pixelization_over_sampling: sub-size 4 where the UNCAPPED source S/N > 3.0, else 2; light-profile bins :175-184
production_source.rectangular_mesh: subhalo_validation scripts/pipelines/rectangular_adapt.py:74-96 (source_pix[2]): af.Model(al.mesh.RectangularBilinearAdaptImage, shape) with al.reg.Adapt; weight priors config/priors/mesh/rectangular.yaml:43-61

production_preset.provenance: subhalo_validation/scripts/pipelines/rectangular_adapt.py (rect_adapt source_pix[2], job 342311): RectangularBilinearAdaptImage shape (32, 32) (MESH_PIXELS_YX :38), regularization Adapt; the rest of the stage (adapt S/N cap, over-sampling, MGE, threads) as hst_source_pix_2 — production data (human ruling 2026-10-24): subtracted S/N adapt image, uncapped over-sampling cut; RectangularBilinearAdaptImage mesh; standard size (human ruling 2026-10-23): rectangular 32x32 -> 35x35 — likelihood-lifecycle 2d (#473, decision D5): the hst_rect_adapt_standard preset (hst, standard size) on the multi_galaxy dataset at hst; light-profile over-sampling [4, 2, 2] at [0.3, 0.6] on every galaxy centre (workspace modeling.py); lens light = the workspace MGE (not the preset's); no positions penalty
production_preset.size_override: production data (human ruling 2026-10-24): subtracted S/N adapt image, uncapped over-sampling cut; RectangularBilinearAdaptImage mesh; standard size (human ruling 2026-10-23): rectangular 32x32 -> 35x35; likelihood-lifecycle 2d (#473, decision D5): the hst_rect_adapt_standard preset (hst, standard size) on the multi_galaxy dataset at hst; light-profile over-sampling [4, 2, 2] at [0.3, 0.6] on every galaxy centre (workspace modeling.py); lens light = the workspace MGE (not the preset's); no positions penalty
